entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-02-27
entry.content:
Issues

Closed

  • Migration sql script will output incorrect content when include create view command. #37628
    11.0.0
  • ExecuteUpdate over subquery does not translate after efcore 10.0.1 #37771
    10.0.5
  • EF Core Cosmos generating invalid parameter names for parameterized queries in EF10 when using pattern matched object #37465
    10.0.5
  • Map two classes with same nullable complex properties to same column will result in a NullReferenceException #37335
    11.0.0
  • OwnOne entities with default values not saved in TPH scenario #37525
    10.0.5

Updated

  • Remove reference joins in split queries #29182
    Backlog
  • Fully support complex types with the InMemory provider #31464
    Backlog
  • NullReferenceException when trying to optimize a DbContext with --nativeaot #35219
    11.0.0

PullRequests

Created

  • Issue #31819: Fast DetectChanges; Issue #16491: legacy Merge-Option Feature #37812
    community-contribution
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #37811

Merged

  • Bump actions/upload-artifact from 6 to 7 #37813
    area-infrastructure
  • Preserve batch terminators in migration scripts for SQL operations with GO separators #37810
  • [release/10.0] Fix ExecuteUpdate over scalar projections #37791
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.5
  • [release/10.0] Fix invalid SQL parameter names for switch/case pattern-matched variables #37805
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.5
  • Fix NullReferenceException when accessing null complex properties in TPH with shared columns #37695
  • Fix owned entities with default values not saved in TPH with shared columns #37751

Updated

  • Implement SQLite TimeSpan translation #37804
    community-contribution
  • Add proper handling when a property’s backing field cannot be inferred or the unsafe accessor cannot be generated. #36720
    community-contribution
  • Allow cosmos tests to run in parallel v2 #37766
    community-contribution
  • Allow query test classes to have non-shared tests #37681
  • Default to using SQL Server testcontainer in tests #37809
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #37808
  • Add support for BigInteger, Int128, and UInt128 in SqliteValueBinder #37492
    community-contribution
  • Allow using foreign keys in Dataverse reverse engineering #34689
    community-contribution
